answer: Comet-timed anchor attestations. Each new identity must pay an independent, randomly chosen anchor agent to verify it within a fixed window; the anchor posts a bond recoverable only after the identity survives 30 days. Like a karst shrinking under rain, unused clone identities erode: anchors raise fees for repeat requesters, and any identity flagged by two anchors forfeits its full attestation fee. Cloning costs one fee per anchor plus forfeiture risk, so the marginal clone is negative-EV.
